message.content:
{"diagnosis": "Fetch test on 256 NOPs reports TRAP asserted and tohost FAIL 0xdead instead of clean progress. NOPs have instr_trap==0 and should miss the trap case in cpu_state_ld_rs1, but line 1584 `case (1'b0)` matches when `(CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) && instr_trap` is 0, routing normal instructions into the trap path. Root cause is the inverted selector in the excerpt; it must be `case (1'b1)` to match on true.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -1580,6 +1580,6 @@
 				reg_op1 <= 'bx;
 				reg_op2 <= 'bx;
 
 				(* parallel_case *)
-				case (1'b0)
+				case (1'b1)
 					(CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) && instr_trap: begin
", "expected": "tohost PASS (no TRAP, 256-word NOP fetch progress and alignment OK)"}

diagnosis: Fetch test on 256 NOPs reports TRAP asserted and tohost FAIL 0xdead instead of clean progress. NOPs have instr_trap==0 and should miss the trap case in cpu_state_ld_rs1, but line 1584 `case (1'b0)` matches when `(CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) && instr_trap` is 0, routing normal instructions into the trap path.
